overview: Based on the published agenda, the Mosinee Tourism Commission was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to welcome a new commission member, review and act on two event grant applications for a basketball tournament and bar box championships, and conduct routine business including approval of minutes and agenda items.

agenda.item: Welcome New Commission Member - New Commission Member Appointment
Discussion and possible action on Event/Project Grant Application - GNBL 7th Grade B-Ball Tournament
Discussion and possible action on Event/Project Grant Application - WI Bar Box Championships

discussions.item: Event/Project Grant Application - GNBL 7th Grade B-Ball Tournament
discussions.body: The commission was scheduled to discuss and potentially act on a grant application related to a GNBL 7th Grade Basketball Tournament. This item was set for consideration as part of the commission's review of event and project funding requests.

discussions.item: Event/Project Grant Application - WI Bar Box Championships
discussions.body: The commission was scheduled to discuss and potentially act on a grant application for the Wisconsin Bar Box Championships. This item was set for consideration as part of the commission's review of event and project funding requests.

actionItems: scheduled to consider action on GNBL 7th Grade B-Ball Tournament grant application
scheduled to consider action on WI Bar Box Championships grant application
